content.headline: Deepfake drill — you are both target and verifier
content.body: Senior officers are likely targets of fake voice notes and videos — and the people citizens call when something suspicious circulates. Run this checklist before you forward or act.
bullets: PAUSE — urgency ("forward immediately") is a manipulation pattern
SOURCE — verified official channel, or just an unknown forward?
INSPECT — lip sync, glitches, unnatural audio
VERIFY — confirm via a second official path (control room / PIO)
ESCALATE — report through IT / cyber cell; do not publicly amplify first
